items.html: But her Daat, which is the five Gevurot of the coronet of Gevura, descended below into her body, according to the root from which it was hewn, as above; and they are in the middle, between her two shoulders, exactly in the middle, between the arm of Hesed and the arm of Gevura. And in the manner that we explained to you concerning the sin of Adam the first, who also brought down the Daat of ZA between his two shoulders, like the Nukva, in the first third of his Tifferet. And it is thus clarified that the female has three Mochin, as is found in the book of the Zohar; but her Hochma and Bina alone are in her head, and the Daat is below, in her body, as mentioned.
